notes.title: Thank you for participating in our first Playtest!
notes.content:
[h2]We survived 🩹
[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45227059/3afbc070a86a5255edfe6c7e3b1bce20ad7878a6.png[/img]

When we first announced the playtest, we said to ourselves that we would be happy if 200 people showed up...

But now more than 2,500 people have had the chance to try out our game! Thank you, everyone, for your dedicated love and feedback. We had a blast watching you play and break the game.

Hope to see you again for another playtest soon™

Here's a small gift from our Art Director, Huffie, for all of you!

notes.title: Kernel Hearts - 1# Multiplayer Closed Alpha in a week!
notes.content:
[p]Hey everyone, Akira here. I'm the Director of Kernel Hearts and I would love to invite all of you to participate of [b] our very first playtest of the game![/b]  

We'll be testing all the multiplayer features alongside two playable characters and a small loop of some game levels, up to the first major boss.

We are a very small team, so testing Multiplayer features and balance is quite the challenge. With your help and feedback, we'll be able to shape the game into something special!!  

[h2]If you want to join the playtest, please complete the form available on our community Discord: [url=discord.gg/kernelhearts]discord.gg/kernelhearts[/url]

[b][h3]FAQ:[/h3][/b]

[b]When?[/b]
Friday 27th of July, around 5PM EST

[b]How long will the playtest last?[/b]
The game will be playable for about a week

[b]How much content there will be on the Playtest?[/b]
Around 5 hours, we added extra lore for those who manage to defeat the final boss more than once

[b]How many players will be able to play at once? Can I play on my own?[/b]
We are expecting 4 players co-op per game, but you can also play solo
